gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
The car broke ___ on the motorway.
We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The police are cracking ___ on unlicensed street vendors.
gaps.explanation: 'Crack down on' = deal firmly with illegal behaviour.
